name: ops/execution-permit-consume-changed-binding-problem-valid
description: RT-05 changed-binding negative: the same stable_execution_key with a CHANGED canonical request (a different host_effect_digest binding) is an idempotency conflict — §13.1 step 6: repeating the same canonical request and key returns the same receipt; a changed request conflicts (gap note G37).

problem.title: consume request differs from the stored canonical request
problem.detail: stable_execution_key exec-key-410 was consumed under a different host_effect_digest binding; a changed canonical request cannot reuse the key — recover the original receipt by replaying the identical canonical request, or prepare a new intent for the new effect
